POWER MECHANICS — TERMLY EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: POWER MECHANICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. When learning Motor Vehicle batteries, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Motor Vehicle batteries.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Motor Vehicle batteries.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Motor Vehicle batteries.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Motor Vehicle batteries.

3. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

4. When learning Electrical Systems, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Electrical Systems.
